question: Which aspects of Rāma are invoked to protect the eyes and ears?
premises: The son of Kauśalyā is asked to protect the two eyes
The one dear to Viśvāmitra is asked to protect the two ears
inference: Different aspects of Rāma are invoked to guard specific sense organs.
plain_english: May the son of Kauśalyā protect the two eyes; may the one dear to Viśvāmitra protect the two ears.
